messages.author: Devika Rao
messages.text: I am speaking at Interaction North on 23-24 June. That is a committed conference slot, not a focus block — I cannot review from a stage.

messages.author: Maren Achterberg
messages.text: Quayside is open the weeks of 22 and 29 June; 13 July is held for finance. Moving Devika's conference is Petra's call only. Nothing pre-approved beyond AP-DK-0106.

messages.author: Rui Saldanha
messages.text: Grace's and Rafael's flex fares re-issue for 250 and 90. Standard queue tickets on the 12th, confirmed the 15th — fine for either June week.
